title: balanced-brackets
statement: The brackets package exposes is_bracket (already implemented) and a stub is_balanced(s). Implement is_balanced(s) so that it returns True when the three kinds of brackets (), [] and {} in the string s are correctly matched and nested, and False otherwise. Characters that are not brackets are ignored. The empty string is balanced. is_balanced must return a bool. Raise TypeError when s is not a string. Do not change is_bracket or the tests.
acceptance_criteria: nested mixed brackets with other characters are balanced: '(a[b]{c})', 'f(x[0], y[1])'
TypeError when s is not a string
